reference_query:
MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(owner:Spec)
OPTIONAL MATCH (referrer:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(sec)
WITH sec,owner,count(DISTINCT referrer) AS refCount
OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(modified:Spec),(cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release)
WHERE modified.specNumber=owner.specNumber AND release.releaseName=owner.specRelease
  AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL
  AND any(token IN split(reduce(clean='', pos IN range(0,size(cr.clausesAffected)-1) | clean + CASE WHEN substring(cr.clausesAffected,pos,1) =~ '[0-9A-Za-z.]' THEN substring(cr.clausesAffected,pos,1) ELSE ' ' END),' ')
      WHERE token =~ '[0-9][A-Za-z0-9]*([.][A-Za-z0-9]+)*[.]?|[A-Z]([.][A-Za-z0-9]+)*[.]?'
        AND CASE WHEN token ENDS WITH '.' THEN substring(token,0,size(token)-1) ELSE token END=sec.sectionNumber)
WITH sec,refCount,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount
RETURN sec.sectionId AS sectionId,crCount,refCount
ORDER BY refCount DESC,sectionId ASC
